review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib for rivals to its declarations. The declarations I checked were unitsEquivPos, NNRat.cast_nonneg and nnqsmul_nonneg. The only other hit for unitsEquivPos is a use in Topology/Algebra/Field.lean. The nearest generic equivalence is unitsEquivNeZero in Algebra/GroupWithZero/Units/Equiv.lean. It covers units of a group with zero versus nonzero elements, which is a different concept from units of Nonneg R versus positive elements, so I don't count it as a competitor. The Inv, Div, zpow, NNRatCast and SMul instances on Nonneg α, together with the divisionSemiring, semifield and linearOrderedCommGroupWithZero instances, are the file's own work to build structure on Nonneg. I found no parallel Mathlib definition of them. The divisionSemiring instance is derived through Subtype.coe_injective.divisionSemiring, so it does not duplicate that machinery. I found no justified duplicate-concept finding.
